name: Zobair Live Sales Notification
author: zobair_d

sections.description:
Zobair Live Sales Notification displays beautiful animated popups showing recent purchases on your WooCommerce store. These social proof notifications build trust and create urgency (FOMO) that converts visitors into buyers.

Key Features

  • ✅ Real orders from your WooCommerce store — no fake data
  • 🎨 3 beautiful popup styles: Modern, Minimal, Bold
  • 📍 4 display positions: Bottom Left, Bottom Right, Top Left, Top Right
  • ⏱ Full timing control: delay, duration, interval
  • 🔁 Auto-loop with shuffle
  • 📱 Mobile hide option
  • 🖼 Product image display
  • 🌍 Customer location display
  • ⚡ 5-minute smart caching for performance
  • 🔤 Fully customizable notification text with {name} and {location} tags
  • 🌐 Translation ready (.pot included)
  • ✨ Live preview in admin

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Live Notifications
  3. Configure your settings
  4. Watch sales notifications appear on your store!

The plugin fetches recent completed/processing orders, caches them for 5 minutes, and displays them as animated popups to visitors.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/wc-live-sales-notification
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Live Notifications to configure
sections.faq:
Does this use real orders or fake data?

Real orders only. The plugin fetches completed/processing orders from your WooCommerce store within the configured time range.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Order data is cached for 5 minutes using WordPress transients. The frontend JS is lightweight vanilla JavaScript with no dependencies.

Can I customize the notification text?

Yes! Use {name} and {location} tags in your custom text. Example: {name} from {location} just bought

Is it GDPR compliant?

The plugin only displays the customer’s first name and city/country (no email, full address, or private data). Review your store’s privacy policy to ensure compliance with your local regulations.

Does it work with page caching?

Yes. The plugin uses WordPress AJAX-safe localized script data. Compatible with WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, and similar plugins.
